_note: Pumpkinseed (Lepomis gibbosus), a common sunfish of weedy Midwest shallows, smaller and rounder than the bluegill. Markings from field-guide descriptions: a deep, round, flat body; olive-gold sides covered in orange and yellow spots; an orange-yellow breast; wavy blue-green lines across the orange cheek; a black ear flap with a bright red-orange spot on its rear edge; long, pointed pectoral fins; a small mouth.
name: Pumpkinseed
